_ayuda: Lista de imágenes realistas que GitHub genera con Gemini (scripts/sortu_irudiak.py). Solo se generan las que aún no existen en estatico/irudiak-errealak/<id>.jpg. Para rehacer una, borra su .jpg. Describe SOLO el contenido: el estilo (realista, fondo blanco, sin texto) se añade solo.

irudiak.prompt: A single human eye viewed from the front, with the iris, pupil, eyelids, and eyelashes clearly visible.
One human outer ear viewed from the side, with its shape and ear canal clearly visible.
A human nose viewed from the front, with the nostrils clearly visible.
A human mouth slightly open, showing the tongue clearly.
A close-up of human fingertips touching a smooth surface.

A young potted plant in the centre receiving what it needs to live: bright sunlight coming from the sun in the upper left, water drops falling from a small watering can on the right, soft air flow lines around the leaves, and rich brown soil in the pot. Each element clearly separated so it can be labeled.

A simple physical world map: the seven continents each in a different soft colour (North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, Oceania, Antarctica), blue oceans, clear coastlines, continents well separated so each can be labeled.
